Rules
prompt_parts.content:
Rules:
- Translate the block as a coherent passage, not as isolated source lines.
- Do not manually insert @h or speaker names. The tool will wrap lines and create game windows automatically.
- Preserve character voice, narrative flow, and important pauses.
- ASCII apostrophes and contractions are allowed. Do not use curly quotes, em dashes, en dashes, or ellipsis characters.
- The English may be longer or shorter than the Japanese if that improves quality.

prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "リンシャに声を掛けてランドの傍らに跪いたシュリは、\nランドの体に向かって掌を翳す。\n神の肉体を持つ俺とシュリは主従関係の他に、\n主と使徒という関係にある。\n使徒とは神もしくはそれに準ずる者から様々な能力を\n与えられる代わりにその者に絶対服従を誓った者達の総称で、\nシュリは自らの意志で俺の使徒となる事を望み、\n俺が分け与えた力で癒しの魔法を使う事が出来る。\nもっとも、力を授けた俺が本来の力を失っている以上、\nシュリも余り大きな力は使えないのだが……",

She and I, who possess divine bodies, share not only a master-servant relationship but also that of lord and apostle. Shuri chose to become my apostle by her own will, and with the power I granted her, she can use healing magic.       "block_id": "s1:block:03039-03040",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rando",
      "jp": "リンシャさん……はっ！　娘、娘が！",

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03046-03047",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "娘って、アリシアちゃんがどうしたの？",

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03049-03049",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "アリシア……俺の頭の中に昨夜の夢が思い出される。",
      "en": "Alicia... I recall the dream from last night."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03055-03056",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rando",
      "jp": "アリシアが、攫われたんです！",
      "en": "Alicia... she's been kidnapped!"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03062-03063",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "なんですってぇ！",
      "en": "What?!"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03065-03072",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "やはり、昨夜の夢は本当にあった事だったか……\n俺は時折こうした夢を見る事がある。\n水の巫女の話では、俺が神殺しによって得たこの肉体の\n本来の持ち主である古き神が、俺に何かを伝えたいが為に\n見せているのだろうと言うのだが……\nいったいこの俺に何をさせようと言うのか……",
      "en": "So the dream last night was real... I sometimes have dreams like this. The Water Maiden says the ancient god who originally owned this body I gained by slaying a god may be showing them to convey something to me... Just what does it want me to do...?"
    },

      "block_id": "s1:block:03074-03075",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "それで、相手は？",
      "en": "And who took her?"
    },

      "block_id": "s1:block:03081-03082",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rando",
      "jp": "判らないんです、町外れの採石場の近くで襲われて……",

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03088-03089",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "そんな所から、その傷で歩いてきたの？",
      "en": "You came here from the quarry with that wound?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03095-03097",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rando",
      "jp": "助けを呼ぼうと……\n此処に来れば誰かが助けてくれるような気がして……",
      "en": "I was trying to call for help...\nI felt like if I came here, someone would help..."

      "block_id": "s1:block:03099-03100",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "……",

      "block_id": "s1:block:03106-03108",

    }
